name: Doji Setsuna
notes:
Kogarashi is a white Utaku steed with a silver mane and tail — lean, swift, and always poised. She was a wedding gift from the Shinjo family and is the one being in Setsuna's life to whom warmth flows without mediation. Ridden equally for pleasure and for political effect, Kogarashi's distinctive Utaku breeding marks Setsuna at distance to any Unicorn who sees her.

Setsuna currently serves Imperial Envoy Miya Misato as her Personal Advisor. Her giri is to see Misato succeed in brokering a peace between the Lion and the Unicorn. Her ninjō is to innovate the trilateral agreement for Toshi Ranbo — for the Crane clan, for her grandmother, and to see to her husband's freedom.

Household

  • Aika — Personal attendant. Former geisha, now in Setsuna's intimate care. Manages hair, dress, and the chamber. Geisha-trained discretion. One of the two senior women of the household.
  • Ishika — Lady's maid and personal attendant. Quiet, middle-aged, motherly. Carries the maternal-continuity register of the household. The second of the two senior women.
  • Otoya — Scribe and legal assistant. A Crane man with encyclopedic knowledge of Imperial law. Setsuna's working partner for document preparation and legal research.
  • Jiro — Horse attendant. A Unicorn, responsible for the care of Kogarashi.
  • Bayushi Monbon — Yojimbo. A Scorpion samurai assigned to Setsuna as punishment duty by his lord, originally without the right of seppuku. Fired by Setsuna at the Ifrit incident and reclaimed at the Midnight Treaty; his ransom was invoiced back to his lord. Currently in functional partnership with her. Carries a bound Lady of Decay that has been growing in visibility.

Family

  • Doji Masateru — Father. Imperial legal scholar, well-versed and emotionally distant. Taught her to wield the law like a sword: a single correct argument, like a single cut, should be fatal.
  • Doji Ayaka — Mother. Arranged her marriage to Harunobu. A year later, advised obliquely that a daughter of the Doji turns infidelities into poetry.
  • Doji Retsuo — Older brother. The model heir. Thinks she is too verbose.
  • Doji Emika — Younger sister. Sees Setsuna as a woman trapped by duty, but keeps her thoughts private. Has no desire to follow in her footsteps. Reserved in Setsuna's plans for the Toshi Ranbo settlement, to marry into the Matsu family and satisfy the grandmother's restoration demand.
  • Matsu Tomoe — Late maternal grandmother. Married into the Crane from the Matsu and hated being a Crane for the rest of her life. Now haunts Setsuna as a ghost, demanding the restoration of Toshi Ranbo and the Matsu lineage.

Marriage

  • Shinjo Harunobu — Husband. A respected Shinjo commander, currently a Lion prisoner of war. Loves her and respects her intellect, though he considers her work legal trickery and prefers to solve problems directly. He understands he has married up. They communicate by letter; the marriage has been long-distance for years.

Mentors and Superiors

  • Bayushi Tomono — Scorpion courtier she encountered in Shirogome. Engaged her in wordplay and taught her how to exploit Imperial law and weaponize harmlessness. One of three people whose approval she cares about.
  • Asahina Shigehiro — Her former lord, Crane shugenja and ruler of the city of Shirogome. Employed her as legal counsel on matters of Imperial law. One of three whose approval matters.
  • Kitsuki Kāgi — Her Emerald Magistrate superior. Recruited her into Imperial service after the Kakita tax loophole brought her to his attention. One of three whose approval matters.

Magistrate Colleagues

  • Kakita Kazumi — Kakita duelist, Topaz Champion, and trained Crane Harrier (shinobi) operating in plain sight. Has consistently shown her discretion and quiet loyalty, including providing logistical support during the abortion procedure.
  • Shiba Midori — Phoenix shugenja. Brewed the abortifacient and conducted the procedure. The sole peer-level intimate with whom Setsuna has been visibly unmasked. Her shugenja presence first allowed the grandmother's ghost to manifest.

Lord

  • Miya Misato — Imperial Envoy, sixteen years old. Originally dispatched on a mission designed to fail. Setsuna appointed herself as her advisor and has invested her own XP transferring skills to her. Nearly assassinated and now blind, but alive. The displaced object of the motherhood Setsuna refused, and simultaneously her operational frame and political instrument.

Adversary

  • Kakita Noritomo — The Kakita provincial daimyō whose new artisan tax Setsuna voided through an Imperial precedent during her time in Shirogome. He banned her from his lands rather than risk a contest he would lose; the institutional grudge remains active in the Kakita family.

The Lover At Court

  • An unnamed member of an Imperial family in Otosan Uchi. Father of the pregnancy Setsuna conceived approximately four months before her departure for Loyalty Castle. He does not know she was pregnant and has never known. Setsuna does not pursue contact.

answers.stand_out: She is a careful and close reader in imperial law, and often finds subtle and surprising interactions within it.

answers.social_giri:
Currently, Kitsuki Kāgi, in service as an Emerald Magistrate under the Emperor.

Previously, she served Asahina Shigehiro, lord of the city of Shirogome, on issues of imperial law and legal arbitration.

Her giri: Rule must bind, and if needed, contort.

answers.social_ninjo:
Strictures too often interfere with a beautiful tale.

She escapes into literature, particularly pillow-books, and riding her horse, Kogorashi, a Utaku steed and wedding gift from her husband's family.

answers.clan_relations: Positive, as she upholds Crane values, although her ruling put her at odds with a Kakita family daimyo.

answers.success:
She served Asahina Shigehiro, lord of the city of Shirogome, on issues of imperial law and legal arbitration. Her most notable moment was when there was a dispute with the provincial daimyo, a Kakita, who attempted to impose new levies on skilled artisans.

She ruled that artisans were protected under an Imperial precedent granting exemptions to craftsmen in service to samurai and the court, citing an edict from Hantei V, which specified examples (non-exclusive) or silk and ceramics which were essential to Imperial culture and could not be overtaxed. The daimyo backed down, knowing that pushing forward could invite scrutiny and a more binding decision from an emerald magistrate.

This situation resulted in both Affect of Harmlessness (Air) and Scorn of Kakita (Water)

answers.calms: At peace when writing poetry and reading pillow books, as well as riding Kogorashi.

answers.most_learn: Bayushi Tomono: A Scorpion courtier visiting Shirogome. Engaged in wordplay with Setsuna, and taught her how to exploit Imperial law and weaponize “harmlessness”.

answers.first_sight:
The first thing people notice about Doji Setsuna is her manner of speech; not just its elegance, but its precision. She speaks in a way that feels deliberate, choosing less ordinary words when a specificity is needed. This can be delightful or discomforting. It also means that when she seems to misspeak, it may have been intentional.

Her otherwise immaculate presentation is consistently marred by stray strands of hair escaping.

answers.stress:
In times of stress, she will usually step forward into a situation, even one that feels dangerous or that she is woefully ill-equipped for, believing that her words might help de-escalate or escape the situation.

When her strife is high, her need for agency rises, and she will try increasingly improbable solutions, and grow curt with people who impede her attempts to cut through to a solution.

The only people whose approval she cares about are Asahina Shigehiro, Bayushi Tomono, and Kitsuki Kāgi.

answers.relations:
Kakita Noritomo: Does not openly acknowledge his disdain, but Setsuna has been barred from Kakita courts and dojos following her ruling.
    - His allies within the Emerald Magistrates may look for opportunities to undermine or discredit her.
Shinjo Harunobu: A respected Shinjo commander. Respects Setsuna’s intellect, but prefers to solve problems directly and not through “legal trickery”. It was a political marriage but they barely speak beyond what is necessary, and Harunobu spends most of his time away on campaign. He sees little value in courtly games and is blind to how Setsuna protects him politically.
Doji Masateru (Father): An imperial legal scholar, well versed, emotionally distant. Taught Setsuna to wield the law like a sword. A single correct argument, like a single cut, should be fatal.
Doji Ayaka (Mother): The marriage to Takahiro was her working, and she cannot claim ignorance; a year after the marriage, she advised obliquely that a “daughter of the Doji turns infidelities into poetry.”
Doji Retsuo (Older Brother): The model heir. Thinks she is too verbose.
Doji Emika (Younger Sister): Sees Setsuna as a woman trapped by duty, but keeps her thoughts private, but has no desire to follow in her footsteps.
Emerald Magistrate Mirumoto Kyou resents Setsuna; she does not seem to cherish her role that she bested him at. He does not understand how she was chosen over him.
Emerald Magistrate Kakita Yoshitada did not support Setsuna’s appointment. Would never openly undermine an Emerald Magistrate. Two decades of experience in Imperial law and dueling arbitration.

answers.parents_pov:
Doji Masateru (Father): An imperial legal scholar, well versed, emotionally distant. Taught Setsuna to wield the law like a sword. A single correct argument, like a single cut, should be fatal.
Doji Ayaka (Mother): The marriage to Takahiro was her working, and she cannot claim ignorance; a year after the marriage, she advised obliquely that a “daughter of the Doji turns infidelities into poetry.”

answers.heritage_name: Named after her great-aunt, who perished nobly in battle. Estate was lost.

answers.death: Setsuna should die unexpectedly and suddenly, so that she does not have a chance to shrink from it or overthink it. It is unlikely that her destiny is fulfilled in this life.

bonds.name: Shinjo Harunobu
bonds.description:
Samurai are expected to place romantic love below their obligations to family and clan—but the human heart is not so easily confined. Many samurai who fall in love keep their relationship secret, while others are more overt. The following are suggested narrative effects for a character with a Lover bond:

  • - A lover seeks to spend time with you, writes letters to you, and is willing to assist you in ways that do not require publicly acknowledging your bond (giving you information key to pursuing a desired goal, encouraging you to pursue your personal interests, helping you to deal with emotions you usually must keep to yourself), and they expect you to do the same.

  • Generally, your lover’s allies do not acknowledge your relationship. Some might be favorably disposed to you covertly if you make their ally happy (and unfavorably disposed if you make them unhappy), while others might be jealous of the attention you receive. Your lover’s enemies might target you to attempt to gain leverage over your lover.

  • If your bond rank is 3 or higher, a lover is more overt about your relationship, allowing them to assist you more publicly (such as giving you letters of introduction to officials above your status, allowing you to use their name to pursue your goals, and even helping you directly), and they expect the same from you.

Bond Ability: With You, the Storm Subsides

titles.name: Personal Advisor to Miya Misato
titles.description:
Advisors serve daimyō, Emerald Magistrates, generals, and other notables with their minds and their words, giving them guidance, ideas, and counsel as requested. A great leader must have access to far more information than any one person can reasonably know, and therefore they employ various specialists and experts who keep them up to speed on dozens of vital topics. As a result, many military strategies, legal precedents, and trade deals are penned by advisors in the name of the one they serve, and these people wield great power as a result.

Assigned By: Daimyō, Emerald Magistrates, military leaders, high-ranking courtiers, and other individuals of import can appoint Advisors, and do so at their discretion.

Status Award: +10 (to a minimum of 40)

Title Ability: Skilled Attendant
